<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. XX.|ACCORDING TO S. LVKE.|197 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=20|verse=20}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 22, 15. Mr. 12, 13.''}}* And watching, they sent spies which should feine them selues iust: that they might take him in his talke, and deliuer him to the principaltie and povver of the Praesident. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=21}}† And they asked him, saying, Maister, vve knovv that thou speakest and teachest rightly: and thou doest not accept person, but teachest the vvay of God in truth. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=22}}† Is it lavvful for vs to giue tribute to Caesar, or no? {{verse|chapter=20|verse=23}}† But considering their guile, he said to them, VVhy tempt you me? {{verse|chapter=20|verse=24}}† Shevv me a penie. VVhose image hath it and inscription? They ansvvering said, Caesars. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=25}}† And he said to them, Render therfore the things that are Caesars, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ So duties must be done to Princes, that our duety to God be not neglected. See Annot. Mat. c. 22, 15.}}∷ to Caesar: and the things that are Gods, to God. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=26}}† And they could not reprehend his vvord before the people: and marueiling at his ansvver, they held their peace.

{{verse|chapter=20|verse=27}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 22, 23. Mr. 12, 18.''}}* And there came certaine of the Sadducees, vvhich denie that there is a resurrection, and they asked him, {{verse|chapter=20|verse=28}}† saying, Maister, Moyses gaue vs in vvriting, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deu. 25, 5.''}}* If a mans brother die hauing a vvife, and he haue no children, that his brother take her to vvife, and raise vp seede to his brother. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=29}}† There vvere therfore seuen brethren: and the first tooke a vvife, and died vvithout children. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=30}}† And the next tooke her, and he died vvithout children. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=31}}† And the third tooke her. In like maner also al the seuen, and they left no seed, and died. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=32}}† Last of al the vvoman died also. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=33}}† In the resurrection therfore, vvhose vvife shal she be of them? sithens the seuen had her to vvife. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=34}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} said to them, The children of this vvorld marrie, and are giuen in mariage: {{verse|chapter=20|verse=35}}† but they that {{sup|‖}} shal be {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The greeke οἱ καταξιωθέντες importeth also this much, ''they that are made worthie'', to wit, by the grace of God, and so they are in deede worthie. as also in the next chapter verse ''36''. & ''2. Thess. 1, 5''.}}∷ counted vvorthie of that vvorld and the resurrection from the dead, neither marrie, nor take vviues, {{verse|chapter=20|verse=36}}† neither can they die any more, for they are {{sup|‖}} equal to Angels: and they are the sonnes of God, seeing they are the sonnes of the resurrection. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=37}}† But that the dead rise againe, Moyses also shevved, beside the bush, as he calleth the Lord, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Exod. 3, 6.''}}* ''The God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Iacob''. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=38}}† For God is not of the dead, but of the liuing. for al liue to him. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=39}}† And certaine of the Scribes answering, said to him, Maister, thou hast said vvel. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=40}}† And further they durst not aske him any thing.

{{verse|chapter=20|verse=41}}† But he said to them, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 22, 44. Mr. 12, 36.''}}* Hovv say they that Christ is the sonne of Dauid? {{verse|chapter=20|verse=42}}† and Dauid him self saith in the booke of psalmes, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 109, 1.''}}* ''The Lord said to my Lord, Sit on my right hand'', {{verse|chapter=20|verse=43}}† ''til I put thine enemies, the foote stoole of thy feete''? {{verse|chapter=20|verse=44}}† Dauid then calleth him Lord: and hovv is he his sonne?<noinclude>{{rh||Bb iij|And}}</noinclude>
